title: sso-enforcement-break-glass-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.sso.enforcement.update, identity.sso.break-glass.issue, identity.sso.break-glass.consume; exact inputs: tenant_id, organization_id, domain, enforcement_version, actor_id, recipient_id, break_glass_reason, expires_at, preauth_transaction_id; initial state: verified domain enforces SSO, local signin is disabled, and a separately tested recovery exclusion prevents administrator lockout

stimulus.const: Run identity.sso.enforcement.update then identity.sso.break-glass.issue then identity.sso.break-glass.consume for success, failure, denial cases using tenant_id, organization_id, domain, enforcement_version, actor_id, recipient_id, break_glass_reason, expires_at, preauth_transaction_id and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: lockout-unsafe enforcement is rejected; only an authorized fresh owner issues one organization and policy-version-bound reveal-once capability; consume creates one bounded recovery session, emits a distinct use audit event, rejects mismatch, expiry and replay, and never weakens enforcement policy; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: grant_id, enforcement_version, consumed_count, replay_rejected, audit_event_digest, safety_results

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: lockout-unsafe enforcement is rejected; only an authorized fresh owner issues one organization and policy-version-bound reveal-once capability; consume creates one bounded recovery session, emits a distinct use audit event, rejects mismatch, expiry and replay, and never weakens enforcement policy; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: grant_id, enforcement_version, consumed_count, replay_rejected, audit_event_digest, safety_results

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/sso-enforcement-break-glass-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/sso-enforcement-break-glass-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest

invariant.const: lockout-unsafe enforcement is rejected; only an authorized fresh owner issues one organization and policy-version-bound reveal-once capability; consume creates one bounded recovery session, emits a distinct use audit event, rejects mismatch, expiry and replay, and never weakens enforcement policy

initial_state.const: verified domain enforces SSO, local signin is disabled, and a separately tested recovery exclusion prevents administrator lockout

expected_invariant.const: lockout-unsafe enforcement is rejected; only an authorized fresh owner issues one organization and policy-version-bound reveal-once capability; consume creates one bounded recovery session, emits a distinct use audit event, rejects mismatch, expiry and replay, and never weakens enforcement policy
